targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Total Customers"
FROM customers

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Total Conversations"
FROM conversations

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Active Conversations"
FROM conversations
WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT ROUND(
  AVG(CASE WHEN success THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100, 1
) AS "Success Rate %"
FROM agent_metrics

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Open Tickets"
FROM tickets
WHERE status = 'OPEN'

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(started_at, $__interval) AS time,
  COUNT(*) AS conversations
FROM conversations
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  e.channel,
  COALESCE(COUNT(c.id), 0) AS total
FROM (VALUES ('EMAIL'), ('WHATSAPP'), ('WEB_FORM'), ('API')) AS e(channel)
LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.initial_channel::text = e.channel
GROUP BY e.channel
ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT
  s.status,
  COALESCE(COUNT(c.id), 0) AS total
FROM (VALUES
  ('ACTIVE'::conversationstatus),
  ('RESOLVED'::conversationstatus),
  ('ESCALATED'::conversationstatus),
  ('CLOSED'::conversationstatus)
) AS s(status)
LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.status = s.status
GROUP BY s.status
ORDER BY
  CASE s.status
    WHEN 'ACTIVE'    THEN 1
    WHEN 'RESOLVED'  THEN 2
    WHEN 'ESCALATED' THEN 3
    WHEN 'CLOSED'    THEN 4
  END

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(created_at, $__interval) AS time,
  ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)) AS avg_latency_ms,
  channel
FROM agent_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, channel
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  SUM(tokens_used) AS total_tokens,
  ROUND(SUM(estimated_cost)::numeric, 2) AS total_cost_usd
FROM agent_metrics

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE success)      AS success_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success)  AS failure_count,
    COUNT(*)                             AS total
  FROM agent_metrics
  WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
)
SELECT 'Success' AS result,
       ROUND(100.0 * success_count / NULLIF(total, 0), 1) AS percentage
FROM totals
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Failure' AS result,
       ROUND(100.0 * failure_count / NULLIF(total, 0), 1) AS percentage
FROM totals
ORDER BY result DESC

SELECT
  c.channel::text AS channel,
  COALESCE(SUM(am.tokens_used), 0) AS total_tokens,
  COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(am.estimated_cost)::numeric, 2)) AS total_cost_usd
FROM unnest(enum_range(NULL::channel)) AS c(channel)
LEFT JOIN agent_metrics am ON am.channel = c.channel
GROUP BY c.channel
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(created_at, $__interval) AS time,
  direction,
  COUNT(*) AS message_count
FROM messages
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, direction
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  e.status,
  COALESCE(COUNT(m.id), 0) AS total
FROM (VALUES ('DELIVERED'), ('SENT'), ('PENDING'), ('FAILED')) AS e(status)
LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.delivery_status::text = e.status
GROUP BY e.status
ORDER BY CASE e.status
  WHEN 'DELIVERED' THEN 1
  WHEN 'SENT'      THEN 2
  WHEN 'PENDING'   THEN 3
  WHEN 'FAILED'    THEN 4
END

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(sentiment_score)::numeric, 3) AS "Sentiment Score"
FROM messages
WHERE sentiment_score IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  e.priority,
  COALESCE(COUNT(t.id), 0) AS total
FROM (VALUES ('CRITICAL'), ('HIGH'), ('MEDIUM'), ('LOW')) AS e(priority)
LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.priority::text = e.priority
GROUP BY e.priority
ORDER BY CASE e.priority
  WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1
  WHEN 'HIGH'     THEN 2
  WHEN 'MEDIUM'   THEN 3
  WHEN 'LOW'      THEN 4
END

SELECT
  e.status,
  COALESCE(COUNT(t.id), 0) AS total
FROM (VALUES ('OPEN'), ('IN_PROGRESS'), ('RESOLVED'), ('CLOSED')) AS e(status)
LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.status::text = e.status
GROUP BY e.status
ORDER BY CASE e.status
  WHEN 'OPEN'        THEN 1
  WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 2
  WHEN 'RESOLVED'    THEN 3
  WHEN 'CLOSED'      THEN 4
END

SELECT
  ROUND(
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 1
  ) AS avg_resolution_hours
FROM tickets
WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL
  AND status IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')

SELECT
  e.channel,
  COALESCE(COUNT(t.id), 0) AS total
FROM (VALUES ('EMAIL'), ('WHATSAPP'), ('WEB_FORM'), ('API')) AS e(channel)
LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.source_channel::text = e.channel
GROUP BY e.channel
ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(received_at, $__interval) AS time,
  processing_status,
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM webhook_delivery_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
GROUP BY 1, processing_status
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN processing_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1
  ) AS failure_rate_pct
FROM webhook_delivery_logs

SELECT
  e.channel,
  COUNT(r.id) AS violations
FROM (VALUES ('EMAIL'), ('WHATSAPP'), ('WEB_FORM'), ('API')) AS e(channel)
LEFT JOIN rate_limit_entries r
  ON r.channel::text = e.channel
  AND r.request_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
GROUP BY e.channel
ORDER BY violations DESC
